notes.title: Hot-trash Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FGLv0YBXMAAAdXH?format=jpg&name=large


*UPDATE*

So rather than fixing anything, this actually borked some players V-Sync options. Including one of the computers in the office. It's been rolled back for now, and we'll try to resolve it and cast it back into the world tomorrow. 



"We're gonna need a crappin' miracle to fix this fix this pile of junk!" - Duque

Ok so maybe not a miracle, but a few hotfix's here and there ought to do the trick. We're working on a slightly meatier patch with mech balancing among other quality of life improvements which you, the glorious Wolfstride community, have raised with us. For now this little duct-tape and glue patch is to repair the following issues:

- VSync issue where the game`s fps would go insanely high
- BDSM issue where the player could get stuck in place

From the bottom of our hustling hearts, thank you so much for supporting one another in the forums, telling your friends about our game and leaving so many awesome reviews. The impact it has on our our day-to-day can't be measured. There's a chance we'll push the larger patch this side of the holidays but we don't want to break the whole game right before we sign off to go and massively enhance our caloric intake over the rest of the month. So we'll have more news on that turkey when it's cooked!

Thanks for everything you lot!

notes.title: Post Release Patch #1
notes.content:
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FF8z83cXMAcmfO9?format=jpg&name=4096x4096

Hey there people trash!!

It's nearly 24 hours since we released our caged animal called Wolfstride into the wild. And let me just say, friends, we are so so grateful you have joined us. We gotta thank those who dropped by, mocked us in a nice way, ate all the free snacks then left, and generally supported us by picking up our indie release on day 1. Making games is, well, it's a wild ride, and we're here for it, and here to make it the best game it can be. You have already played more cumulative hours than any of our testing ever could. Literally thousands of hours, and so bugs have surfaced that we wish we could have caught sooner. And there will be more! But for now we've just patched the following:

- Fixed invisible wall blocker in Hogs Yard
- Fixed keyboard input config on opening splash screen
- Fixed freeze problem with Tackle on Wormageddon fight
- Resolved some SFX issues
- Resolved U.I issues
- Other fixes from testing (can't really say without spoiling anything later in the game) 

That's all for today, but we're still reviewing every comment and every bit of feedback that comes in. 

If you have additional questions or comments, please join us in the Steam Community chat!

If you encounter further bugs, please continue to report them here: https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1

- PW

notes.title: Wolfstride is Available NOW!
notes.content:
The day has finally arrived, and Wolfstride is now available on PC!

A quick refresher on the game:

Wolfstride is a role-playing game about three former partners-in-crime coming to a turning point in their lives. When they inherit a junkyard mecha called Cowboy, they reunite to enter the planet’s most elite mecha competition: the Ultimate Golden God Tournament.

Each member of the team lends their unique experience as they prepare to outwit the best mecha opponents from around the world. Between dog-mechanic Duque, mecha pilot Knife Leopard, and jack-of-all-trades Dominique Shade, the core crew’s got just about everything covered.

That is… until their simple mission to make money unfolds into a deep, slow-burning exploration of their complex lives, the dark choices of their past, and their inevitable fate.

Other things you should know today:


 There is a limited time, 10% launch discount
 The game features nearly 10 hours of full English-language character voice-over
 At launch, you can play with subtitles in English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, and Simplified Chinese. (Look for Japanese next year!)
 The Golden God Edition includes the game, the soundtrack, the 600+ page illustrated script, and desktop and mobile wallpapers

notes.title: Welcome to Rain City
notes.content:
After a few days of running around Rain City to check everything of Shade’s to-do list, you’ll feel right at home in Rain City. Get to know the locals through quick stops at nearby businesses and shake off the long days with memorable nights at the local watering hole. To get you feeling familiar, here’s a few places you can look forward to spending some time… and what little money you have left.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38048762/dcf8ceb3411e95bc52000806a517a5bee29ad1ca.png



The Rambler & Gambler:

We all need a convenience store for the convenience of what it has in store. But there’s something about this place. It’s brand new, fully stocked, always open, but never busy. We used to think it was something to do with the location, but maybe it’s related to the nervous disposition of the owners, like they’re always holding something back. Either way, they sell the freshest pineapples in town, so who can complain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38048762/857d2149723ea5565da55c57fc82abfa0ff31eb8.png


The Crapyard:

It’s ZZ’s domain, well, hers and her cats. You can get all sorts of parts from Zee. She’s pretty famous in old school engineering circles and never sells a dud, but be warned that your purchase might come with some choice observations and a hefty bill to boot. Gear up for a few truth bombs to go with each mainframe upgrade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38048762/0ee23cb18e55e438029ec9f42c8d73fe676558b5.png


The Midnite Rider:

Where you lay your hat is home, but where you lay your drink might become someone else’s if you’re not quick around here. It’s a great spot as long as you keep your head down. Joy is running the place now, and although she set’s a real relaxed vibe around the place, it’s hard to ignore the, eh, interesting characters that have turned up since she took over… and oh, the conversations you’ll overhear. Give Joy a few moments of your time and she will tell you what your drink is, which sounds cool, but could also just be how she keeps her inventory fresh.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38048762/8a25a81e3c3b52a84ba0d62c916b4170fd345100.png

notes.title: Wolfstride's Mecha Battles, Three Ways
notes.content:
Ultimate Golden God Tournament

This is the Ultimate Golden God Tournament. This is what we're working towards. All roads lead to Zhokov Island and its elite fighting arena. Pity you're piloting a humongous pile of crap.

[previewyoutube=2MGqd79GB7c;full][/previewyoutube]

VR Battles

Everyone deserves a test run. Rumors abound that you can import data from your real life mech and run it in a VR battle instead. Probably good to save those last two pennies you have in your bank account...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38048762/30a1d03a26fccfb5d0cfa441f5cc7f4ce3e99ae5.gif

Underground Battles

The prize money in sanctioned fights is pretty good, I mean it keeps the lights in the hangar on. But if you want to make the kind of money that doesn’t show up on your tax returns, you’re gonna want to find a lead on some underground battles. The rules are a little….loose, but so are your morals so you’ll fit right in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38048762/5107bbd25a77329cc3b024f20e0f50de950c6811.gif


So, uh, you ready Knife?
